notes.title: From Chaos: Massive Update Coming + AMA
notes.content:
Greetings Aeterneans! 

We will be holding an AMA at [b]2 PM EST on June 22, 2024[/b] in our Discord to go over some exciting updates on the progress of Abyss Online and gather community feedback for our roadmap! Over the last three weeks, our team has made significant strides in several key areas:

[b]Character and World Saving Systems:[/b] We are refining our character and world save system.

[b]Server Infrastructure:[/b] We now have a sharding system, all servers will be combined into one world. 

[b]User Interface:[/b] Entire UI has been completely revamped, windows can now be opened individually and moved. There is now a fully functioning settings menu and hotkey reassignment.

[b]Animation Systems:[/b] Rebuilt from the ground up for multiplayer optimization.

[b]Auto Attacks:[/b] Ranged weapons, magic weapons, and melee weapons now have a more modern attack system for stamina based attcks. 

[b]Character Creator:[/b] 

[b]Weapons and Armor Systems:[/b] Undergoing a complete rework.

[b]Skills and Particle Effects:[/b] Major overhaul in progress, we have completely revamped the skill system to feel more “snappy” and we have heavily optimized every skill. Undergoing a complete rework, 

[b]World Map:[/b] Points of interest are being added in the beginner zone. We’re also working on a proper starter quest for this area. 

[b]Mobs:[/b] Mobs will properly attack and cast spells as intended. 

[b]Resources:[/b] Resources have been completely overhauled to optimize the game world.

[b]Progression Systems:[/b] We are revisiting our progression system based on player feedback. We require more community input on progression.

[b]Points of Interest being populated include:[/b]
- Small Starter City
- PvP Arena
- Gryphon's Nest
- Troll Cave
- Improved Orc Pit
- Improved Dragon's Roost
- Bandit's Lair
- Graveyard
- At least two secret locations

The above is an extensive amount of work, we are converting the majority of our Unreal Engine code from blueprints into C++ to optimize the game. 

This will be available to players later this year.

Thank you all for your unwavering support on this journey!

The Abyss Online Team

notes.title: From Chaos: Overcoming Bugs and Building a Better Game
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Adventurers![/h1]

As many of you know, our journey into Early Access with Abyss Online has encountered absolute chaos. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. Our team is working tirelessly to address the issues and improve your experience.

We encourage anyone who wished to purchase Abyss to wait at least a few weeks until we sort out the game-breaking bugs that plague our Early Access launch.

Currently we turned our free playtest off so that we can focus on getting game breaking bugs are fixed. Our free playtest will be opened up again in a few weeks.

[h2]Acknowledging the Issues[/h2]
We have heard your concerns and acknowledge the bugs and issues many of you have experienced. We apologize for any frustration caused and are taking immediate steps to address these problems. We are firmly committed to building back stronger and reestablishing trust with our community.

[b]🛠️ Bug List & Fixes in Progress 🛠️[/b]

[b]Game Breaking Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Single Sign-On System: Mostly fixed. Please report any issues!
[*] Invisible Armor/Weapon: Fix in progress, ETA early next week.
[*] HP/Mana Bug: Fix identified, ETA early next week.
[*] Desync: Solution in progress, ETA early next week.
[*] Game Crash on Login: Immediate fix planned, ETA this weekend.
[*] World and Character Saves: Fix coming next week; in the meantime, you will start with resources/equipment to test different systems like building, crafting, and combat in the game.
[*] Heavy focus on optimization: We are improving the way landscapes are rendered, making the game available on more machines.
[*] UI and hotkey rework: We will begin reworking our entire UI and hotkey system. ETA late next week.
[/list]
[h2]Our Plan Moving Forward[/h2]

[b]Frequent and Transparent Communication:[/b]
We will provide regular updates on our progress, addressing both the fixes being made and the new content being developed. Transparency is key to rebuilding trust.

[b]Frequent Updates and Patches:[/b]
Expect frequent updates to address bugs and enhance gameplay. These will be rolled out incrementally to ensure a smoother experience.

[b]Major Content Updates:[/b]
We are planning significant content updates that will introduce new features, improve existing systems, and add more depth to the game. These updates will be milestones in our development journey. Once we fix the main game-breaking issues, we will begin posting more news on this.

[b]Community Engagement:[/b]
Active engagement with our community is crucial. We will be holding Q&A sessions in Discord, engaging on forums, and listening closely to your feedback. Your input will directly influence our development priorities.

[b]Acknowledgement and Apologies:[/b]
We acknowledge the issues and sincerely apologize for any shortcomings. We are committed to making things right and delivering a game worthy of your time and support.

[b]Iterative Improvements:[/b]
Continuous improvement is our goal. We will iteratively enhance the game based on your feedback and ensure that Abyss Online evolves into a game that meets and exceeds your expectations.

[h2]Join Us in Shaping the Future of Abyss Online[/h2]

We understand that the current state of the game may be frustrating, but your feedback and participation are key to creating the world of Aeternea we all dream of. Thank you for embarking on this journey with us, and we look forward to making Abyss Online an unforgettable experience together.

Stay tuned for updates, and may your swords stay sharp and your spells be ever potent!

Warm regards,

The Abyss Online Team

notes.title: Abyss Q1 Update
notes.content:
[h2]🌠 Dear Adventurers of Aeternea, 🌠[/h2]

As we navigate through the early days of March 2024, the journey of Abyss Online has reached new heights, thanks to your unwavering support and enthusiasm. Here's a glance at the milestones we've achieved together and what lies ahead:

[h3]🛠️ Tech and Game Development Achievements:[/h3]
[b]Successful Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.3:[/b] Our transition to UE 5.3 has been a game-changer, resolving previous challenges and unlocking new possibilities for Abyss Online. The engine upgrade has significantly enhanced game performance and visual fidelity.

If you are interested in pre-purchasing the game, hop in Discord, ping a moderator and come test with us before you buy! The servers will be online a lot leading up to Early Access and you feedback is invaluable. If you are in the media and are interested in giving out Steam keys, please email nick@abyssonline.com

[h3]Taipei Game Show Success:[/h3] Our presence at the Taipei Game Show in January was a resounding success! We connected with many of you, shared insights about the game's future, and celebrated with exclusive Abyss collectibles.

[h3]Expanded Testing Platforms:[/h3] We've broadened our testing horizons beyond PC to include Mac, with Mobile and Console platforms later this year. This expansion ensures that more adventurers can explore Aeternea, regardless of their preferred gaming device.

[h3]Early Access Launch Set for April 18th:[/h3] Our journey through Alpha testing has paved the way for an Early Access, we are shipping a constant Stream of updates headed towards our full release later this year.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/30eea14a8c875f5b44ae1a7cce177cb6563612a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/97c7763cd22eea47f36d1ac99ab99f04197ddda1.png[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/e68846f238d7d4cb25d0c979e308437e3017f009.png[/img]

[h3]🌐 Website and Community Engagement:[/h3]
[b]Website Revamp Complete:[/b] Thanks to the incredible talent within our community  our website has undergone a significant transformation. It's now better equipped to serve as the central hub for all things Abyss Online. A community member named Enjie provided the service through his company. If you are interested in a similar site please reach out to him [url=https://www.webvise.io]here[/url]!

[url=https://www.abyssonline.com]Visit Our Website[/url]

[h3]Price Update and Early Access Pricing:[/h3] We've transitioned to our Early Access pricing of $24.95. We are not going to require a mandatory subscription going forward, we will offer an optional subscription later this year for reduced taxes and fast travel fees. 

[h3]Server Tests and Optimization:[/h3] Our recent server tests have been instrumental in optimizing performance, leading to an enhanced starter map that addresses FPS and GPU load issues.

[h3]🎮 Gameplay and Content Updates:[/h3]
[b]Overhaul and Closed Testing Feedback:[/b] Since our last playtest in November, Abyss has undergone a monumental transformation. Every aspect, from animations and particle effects to procedural generation and loot systems, has been refined for Early Access. We are nearly ready to test maps that can host up to 200 players. Please sign up [url=https://forms.gle/9RyaJWCrPG9RbFgT9]here[/url]

[h3]Community-Driven Development:[/h3] Your feedback has been vital. The test center is online, streaming the client and gathering invaluable insights. This collaborative effort is shaping Abyss into a game we all can be proud of.

[h3]🌟 A Look Forward:[/h3]
The path we're on is filled with promise and potential, thanks to your partnership and passion. As we edge closer to Early Access, the adventure within Aeternea grows ever more exciting. Your contributions, whether through feedback, testing, or simply sharing in our collective excitement, are what make this journey so extraordinary.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being an integral part of the Abyss Online community. Here's to forging ahead into a year of unparalleled adventure and discovery in the world of Aeternea!

With deepest gratitude,

The Abyss Team 🐉

notes.title: Abyss October Update
notes.content:
[h1]Abyss Pre-orders[/h1]

Greetings Aeterneans! We have an exciting pre-order opportunity for you. For a limited time, you can pre-order Abyss for just $10 and save up to 75%! This is the lowest price Abyss will ever be, so grab it while you can.

Abyss is now regionally priced so it’s even more affordable for players around the world. We want as many people as possible to experience the magic of Abyss this holiday season.

Pre-ordering now grants you exclusive access to upcoming alpha tests and bonuses like emotes, skins, and more depending on which Pre-order Pack you choose. The $25 pack gets you an emote and the $50 pack gets you an emote and a unique skin. 

These exclusive items will never be available again, so claim them while you can!

Join our Discord to connect with the dev team and provide feedback that helps us iterate quickly.

[b]Performance Optimizations[/b]

We continue to optimize our environments and test them on an array of devices.
As we add biomes, we are seeing performance issues and we are working through them.

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Asian Themed Biome & Armors
[*] Orc Biome & Armors
[*] Troll Biome & Armors
[*] Animated Loot Systems
[/list]

[b]Content Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] We have begun populating towns with decorations and NPCs
[*] Players are beginning to submit maps and we welcome you to do the same!
[/list]

We welcome your constructive feedback which helps us iterate quickly. Please join our Discord where you can connect directly with our development team.

The Abyss team hosted a popular exhibit at Gamescom Singapore and have plans to repeat live demos and AMAs with gamers around the world in Taipei in January! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/79a3101dbd18d84b8ccbff1261147776cf0e7045.jpg[/img]

We deployed 5.2 updates and added Unreal Nanite and Metahuman support. Other game features added include upgraded mining, woodcutting, crafting systems.  

Trolls, orcs, and goblins that function as mobs in the game. Soon they will function as playable races.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/496aae957d8bfafb2c72508dfd153605a3114ec0.gif[/img]

Check our socials for lots of new gameplay videos and get ready to test our new UE 5.2 build as we allow more players access to it!

notes.content:
[h2]October 2023 Unreal 5.2 Upcoming Testing[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/bacc682111500501f417e02c45fa28283d56f73a.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/3ed7f4ee249bd118565730cc952f37462ef76220.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/8ae39464e186036b66dee64f06b8be5a8c6e9cd9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Farewell to 5.1! [/h2]

We want to thank everyone who participated in our closed testing sessions over the past few weekends. The feedback was invaluable and helped us identify areas for improvement as we prepare for our next round of testing.

While some testers felt the visuals needed polish and there was poor FPS, we were encouraged that there were minimal latency issues. Our priority has always been on core gameplay first before aesthetics. Visuals and optimization will continue improving over time.

Here's a look at what we're focusing on for the October builds:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/8aae321c64a136d0f00aad07f9a8d4b052eef411.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/ede9df27c59098d17c87decf1c837bd1817fecec.png[/img][/url]

[b]Performance Optimizations[/b]

Upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.2 and resolved FPS drops
Improved particle effect efficiency
Disabled unnecessary graphical features like motion blur

[b]New Features[/b]

Swimming and underwater gameplay
Revised mana and health UI
Building
Choppable trees, minable ore
Item spawners in new player zone so players can try all weapons
Auto attack improvements and changes
Explosion potions
Mobs
Portals to landmark locations

[b]Content Additions[/b]

More foliage, flora and fauna throughout the world
New combat and PvE focused areas
Continued work on crafting, farming, gathering and housing systems

Our goal remains to have a closed testing build up on Steam as soon as we feel it's in a polished state. We can't wait for more of you to experience the hard work that's gone into Abyss Online over the past year.

As always, we welcome your constructive feedback which helps us iterate quickly. Please join our Discord where you can connect directly with our development team.

notes.title: What is Abyss Online?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547065/70ac4e3ac9061c9e9e0c06a3b6cf3155cac9c020.png[/img]

[h2]Q: What is Abyss Online?[/h2]

A: Abyss Online is an upcoming open-world sandbox MMORPG. It will have a full PvE world with a main story, dungeons, and raids, equalized arenas for competitive PvP, and dedicated open-world PvPvE battlegrounds for larger fights and territory control. It is being developed in Unreal Engine 5 by the indie studio Old World Labs.

[h2]Q: We see you advertising PvP, I hate PvP, can I play your game?[/h2]

A: You do not have to PvP in Abyss Online to enjoy the game. We are building intricate open world player housing systems, a dynamic crafting and resource system, a player created economy, Non-PvP zones and instances, a pet system, and more. Our plans for mobile and browser development are focused on these experiences, we have no plans to implement PvP features on mobile. 

[h2]Q: What kind of server system will Abyss Online have?[/h2]

A: We are using a new system that connects servers globally via Amazon and Unreal. It optimizes latency between servers as needed so players worldwide can fight seamlessly. We have stress-tested with up to 40 concurrent players. Ping is around 70ms, sometimes 140ms globally, but we are tuning skills to work well at those latencies. If you are located near Singapore, Washington DC, or central Europe you will have a competitive ping. If the population grows substantially, we will add more servers.  If issues arise, we may add regional servers, but we strongly prefer one global world. We have planned our growth with experts at Amazon for nearly 2 years. 

[h2]Q: How big is the game world?[/h2]

A: We have maps of varying sizes; we are starting with a smaller 250 sq km open world map with instanced arenas and dungeons via queues. If the population explodes, we also have a larger map ready. Even the smaller map has a lot of open exploration.

[h2]Q: How does the class system work?[/h2]

A: There will be 11 classes at launch, each with 3 subclasses, bringing a lot of diversity. All gear is available to every class, so you can mix and match as you please. A tank priest in heavy armor? Go for it!

[h2]Q: How diverse and interesting will the quests be?[/h2]

A: We have developed an AI-assisted procedural quest and dungeon generation system. It will dynamically create content based on in-game events and your past actions, remembering you and your choices. Over time, it will create fully-fledged dungeons. It's still in testing but will go live in phases this Winter.

[h2]Q: Will there be world bosses?[/h2]

A: Yes, we already have raid bosses, including a dragon. Some will be PvE only, others allow PvP. So, both playstyles are represented.

[h2]Q: How do the arenas work?[/h2]

A: The equalized arenas will scale players to max level, provide arena-only gear, and fully unlock all build customization options for players to compete with. Players will be able to level and gear their characters through arenas for the open world. Leaderboards with seasonal rewards will also be added.

[h2]Q: Will there be PvE content like dungeons?[/h2]

A: Yes, there will be a variety of PvE-only content. An AI-assisted procedural system will dynamically generate quests and dungeons based on player actions and world events.  There will also be raids and an infinite dungeon that scales in both difficulty and rewards.

[h2]Q: What is the character progression system like?[/h2]

A: Every class, subclass, weapon and armor type, infusion, individual skill, crafting discipline, and life skilling path will have their own skill trees to level and customize. Leveling will start out fast, then slow down as players progress.

[h2]Q: What are some of the main features?[/h2]

A: Key features include a robust player-driven economy, dedicated full loot open world PvPvE battlegrounds, guild and faction warfare over territories, equalized arenas, dungeons, raids, player housing and customization, pet breeding/taming, and fluid hybrid tab/action combat.

[h2]Q: What can we expect at launch for player housing?[/h2]

A: Pre-designated zones will allow building anywhere. Houses can be shops, farms, storage, and more. Set fees at your crafting stations for other players. While not essential, player housing enhances immersion.

[h2]Q: What monetization is planned?
[/h2]

A: Buy to play the base game and expansions, mandatory monthly subscription, and Rubies as premium currency to spend on account services such as server transfers, name changes, appearance revisions, cosmetics, and vanity items.  Players will not be able to purchase power at any point with Rubies.  We are anti-P2W.

[h2]Q: What is the ETA for localization?[/h2]

A: This will be a focus over the holiday season. Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, and Mandarin are coming first due to popular demand.

[h2]Q: What is the story behind the game's development?[/h2]

A: Abyss Online originally started under the name Metagates and planned to utilize blockchain elements for trading skins, founder rewards, and tracking rarity of items. However, the team realized that integrating blockchain was not core to the gameplay experience they wanted to create. They rebranded to Abyss Online and shifted focus fully to building a next-gen MMORPG.

[h2]Q: What is the unfiltered story behind the game’s origin?[/h2]

A: In August 2021, my friends and I grew restless waiting for a new MMO. We started a self-funded project on Discord called Metagates, creating basic arena combat and an open world with a basic social element. We started hosting weekly PvP events.

Within weeks, gaming veterans flooded our Discord after trying our free, rough online demo. When asked how we'd fund ongoing development, many suggested blockchain as it was popular in 2021. One night as a joke, we created and individually named 2222 pixelated poops to sell ironic packages modeled after Kickstarter rewards, poking fun at blockchain culture.

We never expected many sales, nor did we even promote the idea. But surprisingly, our satirical poop sold out during a dev stream, raising ~$100k from crypto gamers overnight through sales in January 2021.

As poop prices ballooned 5x-100x, new supporters complained limited rewards wouldn't sustain the game long-term. We expanded products with an anti-hype cash shop to ensure sustainable entry points while still preserving collector rarity. Those products never sold out.

Ultimately, we attracted fans, friends, and angel investors who would support us with or without blockchain. Over two years, we hired the best developers to train us and work on the project beside us to perfect our game and expand it into our full vision.

Though we considered blockchain a feature initially, after closely evaluating the market for years, we do not see it properly happening in our initial vision. We remain focused on creating a great game first and blockchain is a distraction from that.
